recommendation: Keep the no-change audit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless a future work group opens a separate issue to add new positive guidance about deeply nested Parameters.
issue_request: FHIR-37512 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I correction for R5 asking to remove the Parameters.parameter.part comment 'Only one level of nested parameters is allowed' because that restriction was not true and had never been intended.
initial_application: Git commit 1f6276945733a91c610faab8dffce169540f0290, titled 'FHIR-37512 Remove erroneous guidance from Parameters.part', removed the exact comment from source/parameters/structuredefinition-Parameters.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Parameters as an active concrete infrastructure resource, so source/parameters/structuredefinition-Parameters.xml is current build source. FHIR-I minutes from 2022-06-13 record a Persuasive 12-0-0 vote. The originating Zulip thread shows implementers encountering legitimate nested Parameters and Lloyd McKenzie/Grahame Grieve agreeing the note was unsupported. Remaining matches for the sentence are confined to tools/history release snapshots for older releases.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Parameters.parameter.part element contains the correct reusable part definition and contentReference without the deleted one-level nesting comment; editing historical release snapshots would be inappropriate for a current-spec fix.
